description: List media (images/videos) the user has uploaded to their SocialClaw library, newest first. Each asset includes a publicUrl usable directly as media_link in validate_schedule/apply_schedule. Use this to find a previously uploaded file (e.g. from the dashboard) to post. Optionally filter by kind (image/video), mime, or a text query over filename/id.

kind.description: Filter by media kind: image or video.

limit.description: Maximum assets to return. Defaults to 24, capped at 48.

mime.description: Optional mime prefix filter, e.g. video/mp4.

query.description: Optional text match over filename, id, kind, mime, or url.

name: list_assets
title: List assets
